data.hypothesis: Shared-memory staging may reduce repeated source loads across target threads. This candidate keeps the baseline FP32 force arithmetic and self-exclusion to isolate tiling; correctness and performance remain unmeasured.
data.notes: The h01 candidate failed compilation because NVRTC could not open math.h. The h02 proposal was rejected before compilation because its memory-lesson citation was invalid. This revision removes the include and the lesson; the controller still needs to compile and check it. launch.json remains unchanged at 256/256/0.
transformations: Stage source positions and masses in a shared-memory tile reused across target threads.
Keep target particle state in a local variable and retain the baseline force formula, self-interaction exclusion, and velocity-before-position update.
Keep all threads participating in tile barriers, including inactive threads in the final partial block.
